name: Hard to Swallow
source:
Play as transfer student Jaden Jiménez who just got off the plane for his first trip to Japan to mentor under the famous pharmaceutical scientist Dr. O-renji.

Help him develop a drug that helps the user strengthen their own personality traits - undesired flaws or otherwise.

You will start by collecting research data - among other things - from a total of SIX handsome voluntary test subjects.

Surely, nothing can go wrong but, boy, will it feel so right!

[From [url=https://symoneonesym.itch.io/hard-to-swallow]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
扮演转学生贾登·希门尼斯 (Jaden Jiménez)，他刚刚下飞机，第一次前往日本，师从著名药物科学家O-renji博士。

帮助他开发一种药物，帮助使用者强化自己的性格特征——不受欢迎的缺陷或其他。

你将首先从总共六名英俊的自愿测试对象中收集研究数据（除其他外）。

当然，什么都不会出错，但是，孩子，感觉会这么好吗！

[来自[url=https://symoneonesym.itch.io/hard-to-swallow]itch.io[/url]]
